what_happened_next.text: Harley-Davidson grew to more than five times its starting value, far ahead of this set. The US share basket roughly doubled. Wal-Mart, despite its dramatic retail success at the start, finished close to cash. A familiar business success story was not a promise of the highest stock return.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: The Gulf War was ending, stocks were rising, and Wal-Mart had passed Sears. Workers and companies still faced a weak economy.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: Different companies produced very different returns. Harley-Davidson’s large gain came with sharp monthly falls as well as rises. The final total hides that bumpy journey.
reflection.what_faded_away: A retailer’s sales ranking did not settle its investment ranking. A single month’s rally also could not explain the next five years.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: Harley-Davidson’s eventual lead was unknown. Choosing it with the finished chart in hand is much easier than choosing it amid a labor dispute.
